arcmira-mcp-arcmira-arcmira.description: YouTube transcript search and monitoring. Use Arcmira when asked what a YouTube video or podcast said, or when the user writes "use arcmira": exact quotes, often who said it, transcripts, sponsors.

arcmira-mcp-arcmira-brand-mention-monito.description: Use Arcmira to monitor brand mentions on YouTube: how often a company or product comes up, which shows discuss it, whether it's rising, quotes and alerts.

arcmira-mcp-arcmira-company-watch.description: Use Arcmira to watch what YouTube says about a company, podcasts included: recent mentions, counts, momentum and quotes, then alerts.

arcmira-mcp-arcmira-compare-shows.description: Use Arcmira to compare two YouTube channels or podcasts on YouTube: size, latest episode, topics, overlap and shared sponsors. For rival research.

arcmira-mcp-arcmira-find-quotes.description: Use Arcmira to find exact quotes on YouTube, podcasts included: the line, often who said it, the date, and a timestamped link with clip start and end.

arcmira-mcp-arcmira-person-research.description: Use Arcmira to research a person from what they said on YouTube: appearances, their own words with timestamps, who discusses them. For interview prep.

arcmira-mcp-arcmira-podcast-transcript-s.description: Use Arcmira to search podcast transcripts on YouTube for a topic, guest or phrase: which episodes covered it, what was said, and a timestamped link.

arcmira-mcp-arcmira-sponsor-research.description: Use Arcmira for sponsor research on YouTube, podcasts included: who sponsors a show, which shows a brand sponsors, ad-read counts, first and last seen dates.

arcmira-mcp-arcmira-what-did-they-say.description: Use Arcmira when asked what someone said about something: a person's or company's own words from YouTube, with the show, the date and a timestamped link.

arcmira-mcp-arcmira-youtube-clip-finder.description: Use Arcmira to find the clip: search YouTube transcripts for a moment, get a watch link at the second, start and end seconds, and an embed that starts there.

arcmira-mcp-arcmira-youtube-transcript-s.description: Use Arcmira to read or summarize a YouTube video from its link, or to search YouTube transcripts across channels: the exact quote and the second.
